title: ai-diagnosis-NN.json
description: Output of orchestrator/scripts/ai-diagnose.sh — one JSON object per diagnostic run on a failed phase. The 6 model-emitted keys are produced by ai-consult diagnosis reviewType; provider/model/timestamp/cost are augmented by ai-diagnose.sh at write time.

diagnosis.description: 1-3 sentence root-level summary of what went wrong

root_cause.description: The single causal factor (be specific and actionable)

section.description: Exact spec section heading OR file:line

change.description: Precise edit — add/remove/replace, with the new wording if textual

escalation_reason.description: Required when escalate_now=true. Optional otherwise (empty string acceptable).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the diagnostic run

second_opinion_used.description: True when ai-diagnose.js consulted a second provider because the primary returned confidence=low (P2-D).

primary_provider.description: Original provider before second-opinion swap. Only set when second_opinion_used=true.

primary_confidence.description: Original provider's confidence before second-opinion swap. Only set when second_opinion_used=true.
